atoms.text: Now things are hotting up! Edgar is taking you to some volcanoes.

instruction.text: This is Mount Etna in Italy. Find the smoke coming from the volcano to learn more.

feedback.end: This is a volcanic eruption! The smoke coming from the volcano is actually ash, which is a mixture of lots of tiny pieces of rock and glass.

instruction.text: Here is another view of Mount Etna. Find the lava to find out more.

feedback.end: Lava is extremely hot molten rock that comes out of a volcano during an eruption. When molten rock is underground, it is called magma.

instruction.text: Now we are in Hawaii, an area of tropical volcanic islands. Answer Edgar’s questions.

atoms.a: “Can you guess what the weather in Hawaii is like?”
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m10'>Can you guess what the weather in Hawaii is like</voice>

atoms.a: “Can you work out what is flowing into the sea?”
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m10'>Can you work out what is flowing into the sea</voice>

feedback.end: Correct! When lava hits the sea, it cools down and turns back into solid rock. This is how the Hawaiian Islands were formed and how they are still growing!

instruction.text: We’re back at Ben Nevis. Find the snow on the summit to learn more.

feedback.end: Millions of years ago, Ben Nevis was also a volcano! Mountains like this are called extinct volcanoes.

instruction.text: Let’s do some fieldwork! Edgar wants to collect some volcanic ash to test it. Answer Edgar’s questions.

atoms.a: “What could we use to collect the ash?”
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m10'>What could we use to collect the ash</voice>

text: Great! We can use the container to store the ash. Did you know that volcanic ash is full of nutrients and is great for plants?

feedback.wrong: The camera is useful for taking photos, but you can’t collect ash with it!

atoms.a: Lava is molten rock that has come out of a volcano.
Lava is a very cold liquid.
The Hawaiian Islands are shrinking because they are volcanic.
